description: The accepted differences between the legacy and the new kitchensink, and why. Read by the characterization suite and by the facade's shadow compare. Any difference not listed here is a defect. An entry with a 'match' tells the facade which reads it covers. The facade compares REST reads only: the registration page's HTML differs by design.

ignore.generatedIds: Ids are allocated by each system's own sequence: compare everything but the id of a member created during a run.

acceptedDifferences.what: the message of a client-supplied id
acceptedDifferences.new: A member's id is assigned by the server
acceptedDifferences.decision: keep the 400 and the 'error' key; the message is the new system's (assessment R7)

acceptedDifferences.what: two concurrent registrations with one email
acceptedDifferences.decision: fixed: the unique index answers as the pre-check does (assessment R12)
no personal data in logs (assessment R15)

acceptedDifferences.what: GET /rest/members and the page at volume
acceptedDifferences.new: 200, the list streamed; the page paged
acceptedDifferences.decision: fixed: a failure is not a contract (assessment R17); the facade compares the full list only below a size
